resources.string: This device has no internet until it returns. Go direct for now, and the exit node comes back on by itself when %1$s does.
Traffic leaves without an exit node. It goes through %1$s again as soon as it is back online.
Go direct by itself when the exit node is offline
Without this, a notification asks first. With it, traffic leaves directly as soon as the exit node drops off, which shows this device\'s own address, and the exit node comes back on when it returns.
